description: This file defines the Extract class with static methods for string manipulation functions such as left, mid, right, before, and after, used for text data extraction in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Extract
classes.description: A class providing static methods for extracting parts of strings, such as left, mid, right, before, and after, for use in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the start of a string or array of strings.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a string starting at a specified position with a specified length.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the end of a string or array of strings.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Extracts the part of a string before a specified delimiter, with options for instance and match mode.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Extracts the part of a string after a specified delimiter, with options for instance and match mode.
